e7_s4_rationale: The patient has a history of adenocarcinoma of the ascending colon, and the liver lesion was found 13 months after surgery, which is a common timeframe for metastasis to occur. The presence of a solid and cystic component in the liver tumor and the absence of the right portal vein with a perfusion defect suggestive of portal vein tumor thrombus also support this diagnosis.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Normal tumor markers including α-fetoprotein and PIVKA-II make this diagnosis less likely

e7_s4_rejected.label: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: No communication with the biliary tree on endoscopic retrograde cholangiography and negative bile cytology for malignancy make this diagnosis less likely

e7_s4_rejected.label: Biliary cystadenocarcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: The solid component of the liver tumor and the absence of the right portal vein with a perfusion defect are not typical for this diagnosis

e7_s4_rejected.label: Hepatic adenoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: The patient's history of adenocarcinoma of the ascending colon and the presence of a portal vein tumor thrombus make this benign diagnosis unlikely

B06_pred: Metastatic colorectal cancer to the liver; Hepatocellular carcinoma with portal vein tumor thrombus
